AI & Marketing ConceptsTerm of the week · 2026-W39

Humanwashing

The practice of making AI-assisted work look fully human-made, through handcrafted styling, named creators or behind-the-scenes stories, while hiding how much AI actually did.

Why this week

As the 2026 backlash against AI-made ads grows, brands are tempted to hide their AI use behind handmade, human-looking work. This week's coverage of the 'human moat' as the last brand differentiator puts that trade-off on the table.

Explanation

Humanwashing is the mirror image of AI washing: instead of overstating AI to borrow a tech halo, a brand understates AI to protect an authenticity halo. Business ethicist Peter Seele introduced 'humanwashing of machines' in a March 2021 post, and in 2022 formalized it with Andreea Scorici and Mario Schultz in AI & Society as the deceptive use of a machine's human-like appearance to mislead people about what it can really do. Marketing writers then took the word over for brand and creative work: the WHAT'S ANU newsletter in December 2025, followed by agencies such as Flux+Form in 2026, where it now means passing off AI-generated content as human craft. The risk for marketers is trust: when undisclosed AI use surfaces, the brand is judged less on the AI itself than on the concealment.

Usage context / examples

In August 2025 J.Crew posted AI-generated images styled as vintage catalog shots on Instagram without saying they were AI-made. After the newsletter Blackbird Spyplane exposed them on 26 August 2025, the brand edited its captions to credit an 'AI photographer' rather than stating plainly that the images were AI-generated.

MMA connection

The question sits in the territory of MMA's AI Leadership Think Tank (ALTT, formerly the AI Leadership Coalition), which runs a Responsible AI working group and the Responsible AI Innovation Lab (RAIL), a source of guidelines, templates and checklists for ethical AI use in marketing. It is also the counterpart of AI Washing, already in this dictionary: one overclaims AI, the other hides it, and both erode the same asset, consumer trust.

Related terms

AI Washing, Synthetic Trust, Synthetic Influence, Responsible AI, Greenwashing

Turkish definition

Humanwashing, yapay zeka ile üretilen bir işi el emeği görünümü, isimlendirilmiş yaratıcılar ya da kamera arkası hikâyelerle tamamen insan yapımı gibi sunarak yapay zekanın katkısını gizlemektir.
